# AshOban

Welcome! This is the extension for integrating [Ash](https://hexdocs.pm/ash) resources with [Oban](https://hexdocs.pm/oban). This extension allows you to easily execute resource actions in the background, and trigger actions based on data conditions.

## Tutorials

- [Getting Started with AshOban](documentation/tutorials/getting-started-with-ash-oban.md)

## Topics

- [Triggers and Scheduled Actions](documentation/topics/triggers-and-scheduled-actions.md)

## Reference

- [AshOban DSL](documentation/dsls/DSL-AshOban.md)

---

# AshOban.ActorPersister

Source: https://ash-oban.hexdocs.pm/AshOban.ActorPersister.md

# `AshOban.ActorPersister`
[🔗](https://github.com/ash-project/ash_oban/blob/v0.8.10/lib/actor_persister.ex#L5)

A behaviour for storing and retrieving an actor from oban job arguments

# `actor`

```elixir
@type actor() :: any()
```

# `actor_json`

```elixir
@type actor_json() :: any()
```

# `lookup`

```elixir
@callback lookup(actor_json :: actor_json() | nil) ::
  {:ok, actor() | nil} | {:error, Ash.Error.t()}
```

# `store`

```elixir
@callback store(actor :: actor()) :: actor_json :: actor_json()
```

# AshOban.Chunks

Source: https://ash-oban.hexdocs.pm/AshOban.Chunks.md

# `AshOban.Chunks`
[🔗](https://github.com/ash-project/ash_oban/blob/v0.8.10/lib/ash_oban.ex#L8)

Configuration for chunk-based batch processing using Oban Pro's ChunkWorker.

# `t`

```elixir
@type t() :: %AshOban.Chunks{
  __spark_metadata__: term(),
  by: [atom()] | nil,
  size: pos_integer(),
  timeout: pos_integer()
}
```

---

*Consult [api-reference.md](api-reference.md) for complete listing*

# AshOban.Igniter

Source: https://ash-oban.hexdocs.pm/AshOban.Igniter.md

# `AshOban.Igniter`
[🔗](https://github.com/ash-project/ash_oban/blob/v0.8.10/lib/igniter.ex#L6)

Codemods and utilities for resources that use `AshOban`.

# `add_new_trigger`

Adds the given code block to the resource's `triggers` block if there is no existing trigger with the given name

# `add_trigger`

Adds the given code block to the resource's `triggers` block

# `defines_trigger`

```elixir
@spec defines_trigger(Igniter.t(), Ash.Resource.t(), atom()) ::
  {Igniter.t(), true | false}
```

Returns true if the given resource defines a trigger with the provided name

# AshOban.Verifiers.VerifyUseTenantFromRecord

Source: https://ash-oban.hexdocs.pm/AshOban.Verifiers.VerifyUseTenantFromRecord.md

# `AshOban.Verifiers.VerifyUseTenantFromRecord`
[🔗](https://github.com/ash-project/ash_oban/blob/v0.8.10/lib/verifiers/verify_use_tenant_from_record.ex#L5)

Verifies that when `use_tenant_from_record?` is set to true, the multitenancy
`parse_attribute` and `tenant_from_attribute` options are either both at their
defaults or both customized.

# mix ash_oban.install

Source: https://ash-oban.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshOban.Install.md

# `mix ash_oban.install`
[🔗](https://github.com/ash-project/ash_oban/blob/v0.8.10/lib/mix/tasks/ash_oban.install.ex#L30)

Installs AshOban and Oban

## Example

```bash
mix igniter.install ash_oban
```

# mix ash_oban.set_default_module_names

Source: https://ash-oban.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshOban.SetDefaultModuleNames.md

# `mix ash_oban.set_default_module_names`
[🔗](https://github.com/ash-project/ash_oban/blob/v0.8.10/lib/mix/tasks/ash_oban.set_default_module_names.ex#L34)

Set module names to their default values for triggers and scheduled actions

Each trigger must have a defined module name, otherwise changing
the name of the trigger will lead to "dangling" jobs. See the
`AshOban` documentation for more.

## Example

```bash
mix ash_oban.set_default_module_names
```
